failure_handling.timeout_or_api_error: Run fails; retried only as a new run index, never by editing the failed run's record.
failure_handling.tool_not_allowlisted_or_invalid_args: Recorded as error, not executed; if the pipeline cannot proceed -> run fails.

hidden_label_boundary.hidden_label_inspection: No hidden label was computed, inspected, or stored during freezing. The freeze script parsed hidden outcome columns for nothing and wrote none.
hidden_label_boundary.information_boundary: Arms see train items (all columns + scores) and hidden candidate identities (ordered NSC pair + CELLNAME + grid size + concentration grid, no outcomes). Arms NEVER see hidden combination rows' PERCENTGROWTH, EXPECTEDGROWTH, or SCORE, or any aggregate thereof, and hidden labels are never passed to expert proposal generation. Single-agent rows are visible as assay context only: they carry no combination outcome, and a label cannot be derived from them alone (it requires hidden combination PERCENTGROWTH).
hidden_label_boundary.label_rule: Hidden HIT/BORDERLINE labels are Python-computed from file columns at scoring time only, after both arms have run.
